description:

description:

description:

Matt and Frankie investigate a woman's suspicious cattle ranch amid a crisis threatening competing ranches in Sweetwater, Wyo.

Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

description:

The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

description:

Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

description:

Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

description:

Cisco and Pancho attempt to convince a freighting company owner that her competitor did not steal from her wagons.

description:

A phony sheriff is part of a rustling scheme.

description:

Cisco and Pancho discover the shady motives of a lawyer hired to change a rancher's will.

description:

Frankie befriends an outlaw after his gang robs the train.

description:

While investigating a train robbery, Matt Clark learns about Johnny Ringo; Frankie gets a job doing undercover work; Matt tracks Johnny down.

description:

Former deputies plan on robbing a gold shipment after their brother is killed.

Doc Holiday
Detective Matt Clark and his partner Frankie head to Tombstone, Arizona to find Doc Holliday with suspicion that Holliday is involved in the gang activity there; starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle.

description:

description:

A Tuscarawas brave tries to start a war between his people and the white men.

description:

A young woman with a past and a Seneca Chief attempt to stir the Iroquois into war with the settlers.

description:

A young soldier is accused of stealing new breech-loading rifles and selling them to the Indians; he is being tried for treason unless Hawkeye can discover the truth.

description:

Mike is returning home to marry but his fiancé and family have been murdered in what appears to be a Huron raid.

description:

Tolliver and his outlaw gang of former pirates have kidnapped two women and demanded a ransom of 1000 pounds; Hawkeye infiltrates the gang in an attempt to get them back.

Chief Black Wolf and his tribe are accused of breaking the treaty; it is up to Hawkeye and Chingachgook to clear them.

Surveyor George Washington aids a young woman whose land grant is threatened by a wicked innkeeper.

title: The Man From Utah
